articles.title: FPIs Turn Net Sellers, Pull ₹35,860 Crore From Indian Equities in September
articles.excerpt: A two-month buying streak ended as elevated US bond yields, high crude prices and a rotation into AI-led markets pushed foreign investors to the exits, putting 2026 on track for record annual outflows.
articles.nri_angle: For India-focused investors in the US and globally, the record pace of foreign withdrawals shows global capital is pricing Indian equities against high US yields and elevated valuations — a re-rating, not a dismissal, of the India growth story.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Accenture's Beat Sparks Rally Hopes for TCS, Infosys, Wipro Ahead of Monday's Reopen
articles.excerpt: After Accenture's strong quarter and near-6% surges in Infosys and Wipro's US-listed shares, analysts expect a gap-up opening for Indian IT stocks on October 5 — but caution the pop may be short-lived.
articles.image_caption: Stock market charts showing IT sector performance. Analysts expect Indian IT stocks to gap up on Monday, October 5, after Accentures better-than-expected quarterly results lifted Infosys and Wipro ADRs.
articles.nri_angle: US-based Indian tech professionals face the same demand cycle, and IT stocks are a core anchor of many NRI portfolios — a genuine sector recovery would matter for both jobs and investments.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Eurozone Inflation Jumps to 3.8% in September, a Three-Year High, on Energy Costs
articles.excerpt: Energy prices surged 18.8% on the year as oil topped $105 a barrel, beating economists' 3.6% forecast and piling pressure on the ECB ahead of its October 29 meeting.
articles.image_caption: ECB President Christine Lagarde. Eurozone inflation jumped to 3.8% in September, a three-year high, driven by energy prices up 18.8%.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs across Europe face higher living costs, and a hawkish ECB keeps the euro firm against the rupee just as the RBI's policy call approaches on October 7.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Global Food Prices Hit Four-Year High as El Niño Fears and Black Sea Disruption Bite
articles.excerpt: The FAO Food Price Index reached 136.0 in September, its highest since November 2022, as sugar hit an 18-month high and wheat futures a three-year peak.
articles.image_caption: A shopper pushes a cart of grocery bags through a store parking lot. The FAO said September food prices reached their highest level since November 2022, driven by rising cereal, sugar and vegetable oil costs.
articles.nri_angle: India is the world's largest edible-oil importer, so FAO's warning on pass-through lands directly on cooking-oil costs for Indian households; NRIs abroad also face rising grocery bills.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ICICI Life Names Sidharatha Mishra MD and CEO as Anup Bagchi Departs for HDFC Bank
articles.excerpt: The insurer's board appointed Mishra for a five-year term effective October 14, subject to IRDAI approval, after Bagchi resigned to take over as HDFC Bank chief on October 27.
articles.image_caption: An ICICI Bank branch; subsidiary ICICI Prudential Life has named Sidharatha Mishra as its new MD and CEO.
articles.nri_angle: NRI customers form a meaningful part of ICICI Bank's deposit base, and Mishra's background running the bank's NRI and digital businesses signals continuity in cross-border products.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jio Platforms Wraps Global Roadshows, Readies Papers for $3.8 Billion IPO
articles.excerpt: After investor meetings across the US, UK, Dubai, Singapore and Hong Kong, Reliance's digital arm is preparing its Red Herring Prospectus for what would be India's largest-ever listing.
articles.image_caption: Jio Platforms, led by Mukesh Ambani's Reliance, wrapped up global roadshows ahead of a proposed .8 billion IPO.
articles.nri_angle: The Jio Platforms listing gives NRI investors a rare direct entry into India's digital story, with Meta and Google as backers and a $137 billion valuation as the global benchmark.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Group Reaffirms Rs 6 Lakh Crore Investment Blueprint for Maharashtra
articles.excerpt: Pranav Adani said projects worth Rs 2.6 lakh crore — over 43% of the blueprint — are already completed or under execution, as Maharashtra chases its $1 trillion economy target by 2030.
articles.image_caption: Adani Enterprises director Pranav Adani, in a file photo. He announced the Adani Group's investment blueprint of over Rs 6 lakh crore for Maharashtra at the Invest Maharashtra launch in Mumbai, saying projects worth Rs 2.6 lakh crore are already completed or under execution.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with Adani stock or India-fund exposure face concentrated exposure to one state's regulatory environment; global bondholders will watch whether the 43% execution pace sustains.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Moneyview Shares End Market Debut 59% Above Issue Price
articles.excerpt: The digital lender listed at Rs 55.6 on the BSE — a 64% premium to its Rs 34 IPO price — and closed its maiden session at Rs 54.03 with a Rs 9,510 crore market cap.
articles.image_caption: An Inc42 illustration shows Moneyview's app and branding around its market debut. The digital lender's shares closed their first trading day at Rs 54.03, about 59% above the Rs 34 issue price.
articles.nri_angle: Another data point in India's 2026 IPO boom for diaspora investors watching Indian fintech through mutual funds and fintech ETFs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Mortgage Rates Post Biggest Weekly Jump in Four Years, Hit 7.28%
articles.excerpt: Freddie Mac's weekly survey showed the average 30-year fixed rate surging to 7.28% on October 1, the highest since November 2023, as a Treasury sell-off rippled into housing.
articles.image_caption: US mortgage rates posted their biggest weekly jump in four years, hitting 7.28% as the 10-year Treasury yield neared a quarter-century high.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American buyers in high-cost markets (Bay Area, Seattle, New Jersey) face roughly $313 more a month on a $500k loan than a year ago.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Startups Raise $397 Million Across 19 Deals in September's Strongest Funding Week
articles.excerpt: DMI Finance's $152 million debt raise and Ampin Energy Transition's $100 million Series E headlined the September 21–26 week, with Ultraviolette and Ema closing the biggest equity rounds.
articles.image_caption: Startup funding data illustration. Indian startups raised over $397 million across 19 deals in the week of September 21–26, 2026, led by DMI Finance's $152 million debt raise.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors and NRI angels allocating to India get a disciplined, sector-diverse week — foreign leads like Norfund, Yali and TDK Ventures show global capital riding the same rails.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Middle East Oil Exports Rebound to Near Pre-War Levels as Crude Prices Stay Volatile
articles.excerpt: Crude flows from the Gulf have recovered to about 98% of pre-war levels through overland pipelines and ship-to-ship transfers, but Brent prices remain volatile near $97–102 as tanker attacks continue and the U.S. sends a third carrier group to the region.
articles.image_caption: An illustration shows oil barrels and a pump jack at sunset. Crude exports from the Gulf have rebounded to about 98% of pre-war levels through overland pipelines and ship-to-ship transfers, though Brent prices remain volatile near $97-102 a barrel as tanker attacks continue.
articles.nri_angle: The Gulf's crude matters directly to India, which imports the bulk of its oil from the region: a sustained export recovery would ease India's import bill and take pressure off fuel prices and the rupee, while any renewed disruption hits Indian households and the government's finances first.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nike Stock Plunges 8.5% After Revenue Miss, Steep Forecast Cut and Job-Cut Plan
articles.excerpt: Nike reported $11.21 billion in quarterly revenue, below Wall Street estimates, and warned full-year revenue will decline by a high single-digit percentage — unveiling a 'Pace' restructuring with job cuts and a new India campus.
articles.image_caption: The Nike swoosh logo displayed at a company store. Nike shares fell 8.5% in extended trading after the company missed revenue estimates and warned full-year revenue would decline by a high single-digit percentage.
articles.nri_angle: Nike's planned new India campus — framed as offering "strong capabilities and access to talent" — positions India as the brand's next hub for design, engineering and supply-chain talent even as it cuts roles elsewhere.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed's Jefferson Flags High Inflation, Urges Patience on October Rate Decision
articles.excerpt: In a Thursday speech at the University of Virginia, Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said inflation has run above the 2% target for more than five years, even as he signaled officials may hold rates at the October 27–28 meeting to assess incoming data.
articles.image_caption: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson
articles.nri_angle: A Fed hold is practical news for Indian diaspora households in the United States: it takes pressure off mortgage rates and dollar savings, while investors with stakes in Indian equities and the rupee benefit from less capital-flight pressure each time a U.S. hike is deferred.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Simply Wall St's Top Founder-Led Stocks to Watch in September: Paytm, Marico and Lenskart
articles.excerpt: Founder-led Indian companies are back in focus as borrowing costs stay firm. Simply Wall St's September 2026 screen spotlights Paytm's profitability turnaround and UPI tailwind, Marico's copra-driven margin recovery, and Lenskart's post-IPO momentum.
articles.image_caption: The National Stock Exchange in Mumbai. A new report names Paytm, Marico and other founder-led companies among the stocks to watch in September.
articles.nri_angle: A global investor read on three founder-led Indian companies in payments, consumer goods and retail, with no diaspora-specific angle.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian-Origin Founders Built $560 Billion of Unicorn Value Abroad, Report Finds
articles.excerpt: The Prosus-Dealroom Indian Diaspora Index found 205 overseas unicorns with at least one founder who grew up in India — worth more than the $349 billion attributed to 102 India-based unicorns.
articles.image_caption: Silicon Valley, looking south toward downtown San Jose. A new report finds Indian-origin founders built $560 billion of unicorn value abroad.
articles.nri_angle: The index quantifies the diaspora's outsized role in global tech value creation, with Indian-origin founders driving $560 billion of unicorn value mostly from the US.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: CLSA Holds Course on TCS, Infosys, HCLTech as Nifty IT Slides Third Day
articles.excerpt: The brokerage warned that cautious demand commentary, geopolitics, higher interest rates and inflation could weigh on Indian IT earnings, as the Nifty IT index fell for a third straight session.
articles.image_caption: The Infosys campus in Mysuru. CLSA held its course on TCS, Infosys and HCLTech as the Nifty IT index slid for a third straight day.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT stocks are core holdings for many diaspora portfolios, and CLSA's sustained Hold stance signals the large caps may stay range-bound until earnings reaccelerate.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India-New Zealand FTA Takes Effect Oct. 20 With Zero-Duty Indian Exports
articles.excerpt: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal and his New Zealand counterpart confirmed the October 20 start date after both countries completed ratification, opening duty-free access for every Indian export to New Zealand.
articles.image_caption: New Zealand Trade and Investment Minister Todd McClay and India’s Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal shake hands during trade talks, with the flags of both countries behind them. The ministers announced on September 21 that the India–New Zealand free trade agreement will enter into force on October 20, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Indian exporters — including MSME owners in the diaspora who source or distribute through India — gain zero-duty access to New Zealand from October 20, with engineering goods the biggest beneficiary.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: IPL Worth $20.6 Billion as Private Equity Reshapes Cricket Business
articles.excerpt: Houlihan Lokey values the IPL at $20.6 billion after a record year of franchise sales and a media-rights boom, as global investors pile into what is becoming sport's most lucrative asset class.
articles.image_caption: An editorial illustration shows the IPL logo with a batsman silhouette amid falling Indian 500-rupee notes and golden confetti. Houlihan Lokey's 2026 valuation pegs the league's business at $20.6 billion.
articles.nri_angle: The IPL's nearly one-billion-strong global audience includes a large North American viewership that has made the league a prime-time fixture for Indian diaspora households.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 100% Tariff Threat Sharpens India's Push for Trade Deals Beyond the U.S.
articles.excerpt: With Washington poised to authorize tariffs of up to 100% on Russian oil buyers, India is racing to diversify through new trade pacts with the UK and EU — but economists doubt they can quickly replace the American market.
articles.image_caption: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal gestures while speaking at an industry event in New Delhi. Goyal is steering India's push for new trade deals as the US threatens tariffs of up to 100% on top buyers of Russian energy.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American investors and small businesses sourcing from India face rising costs and portfolio exposure as tariffs climb, while the UK and EU pacts may redirect where Indian exporters sell.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Retreats From One-Week High as Firmer Dollar, Rate-Hike Bets Take Hold
articles.excerpt: Friday's rally to $4,399 an ounce unwound Monday as profit-taking met a stronger dollar and a synchronized central-bank tightening wave, with the Bank of Japan joining the Fed and ECB.
articles.nri_angle: Indian gold buyers get a brief window after Friday's spike, though the global rate-hike cycle now priced in will drive the metal's next move.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hyderabad Leads India's Record GCC Boom With 40 New Centres
articles.excerpt: India added 111 new global capability centres in the first eight months of 2026, already beating 2025's full-year record — and Hyderabad took the top slot ahead of Bengaluru.
articles.nri_angle: India's GCC boom offers returning-NRI tech professionals globally branded employers and dollar-grade work, with salary premiums narrowing the gap to US levels in scarce skills.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Buildout Overtakes Housing as America's Top Investment Engine
articles.excerpt: Real spending on data centers and computer hardware hit $752 billion in the second quarter, surpassing residential investment for the first time — a milestone that shows where the economy's confidence now sits.
articles.image_caption: A data center facility. AI infrastructure buildout has overtaken housing as America's top investment engine.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-Americans are heavily represented in the technology sector driving this buildout, from hyperscaler engineering teams to data-center construction and semiconductor supply chains, making the shift a direct read on the industry many in the community work in.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Stock Futures Edge Up After Dow's Third Straight Weekly Loss
articles.excerpt: Index futures pointed to a modestly higher open early Monday as investors steadied after the Dow's worst week since March, with oil prices and the coming Trump-Xi summit setting the week's tone.
articles.image_caption: The trading floor of the New York Stock Exchange.
articles.nri_angle: Many Indian-American households hold diversified U.S. equity exposure through 401(k)s and brokerage accounts, so a volatile September shaped by rates and oil prices directly affects year-end retirement balances.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Blackstone Says India Is Nearing a Tipping Point for Foreign Capital
articles.excerpt: Jon Gray told Bloomberg Television that India now generates Blackstone's best private-equity returns in the world — a reversal from the years it "did basically nothing" there.
articles.image_caption: A Blackstone sign stands outside one of the firm's offices. Blackstone executives say India is nearing a tipping point for foreign capital inflows.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors weighing India allocations, Blackstone's verdict reframes the trade: the world's largest alternative asset manager says India has moved from a long-dated demographic promise to its best-performing private-equity market on actual returns.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI's Wobbly House of Cards Is Now a Risk to Markets and the Economy
articles.excerpt: Circular deals between OpenAI, Nvidia and Oracle have funded a $1 trillion AI buildout. Now credit markets are questioning who can actually pay for it.
articles.image_caption: The New York Stock Exchange. Analysts warn the AI trade's wobbly valuations are becoming a risk to markets and the broader economy.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian and diaspora investors with heavy exposure to U.S. tech stocks, index funds and Big Tech debt, the AI financing chain is now a portfolio-level risk, not just a tech story.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed Delivers First Rate Hike Since 2023 as Sticky Inflation Meets a Stronger Economy
articles.excerpt: The Federal Reserve lifted its benchmark rate to 3.75%–4.00% in a unanimous vote, arguing a resilient economy gives it room to attack inflation it now says won't reach 2% until 2029.
articles.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve Board Building in Washington, D.C. The Fed delivered its first rate hike since 2023 amid sticky inflation.
articles.nri_angle: Higher-for-longer U.S. rates support dollar strength and elevated bond yields — relevant for NRIs holding U.S. cash, fixed-income investments, and remittance timing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India set for 'unparalleled' decades-long growth, says Tata chief Chandrasekaran
articles.excerpt: Speaking at Sai University's convocation in Chennai, the Tata Sons chairman said AI would create industries that don't exist today and told graduates to treat careers as marathons — while arguing India's economic rise could run for decades.
articles.image_caption: N Chandrasekaran, chairman of Tata Sons, speaks at a podium against a purple backdrop. Addressing Sai University's convocation in Chennai, he said India is entering a period of economic growth unparalleled in its history.
articles.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora weighs investing and building back home against opportunities abroad, and Chandrasekaran's decades-long India growth outlook frames where that overseas capital and talent flow next.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's exports to China jump 39% as core BRICS shipments rise 34% to $19.9 billion
articles.excerpt: Commerce ministry data show shipments to China, South Africa, Brazil and Russia reached $19.9 billion in the first five months of the fiscal year, lifting the bloc's share of India's export basket to 9.2%.
articles.image_caption: A container ship loads cargo at the Hai Phong International Container Terminal. India's exports to China rose 39% in April–August 2026-27 on engineering goods, electronics and petroleum products.
articles.nri_angle: India's record export run and its growing BRICS footprint strengthen the rupee's earnings base, which supports NRI remittance value and diaspora investment confidence.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Saudi Arabia exits China-led mBridge currency platform in blow to de-dollarization push
articles.excerpt: Riyadh's central bank says it completed its proof of concept in May 2025 and never intended to stay; the quiet exit, reported by the Financial Times, removes the world's top oil exporter from a system built to sidestep the dollar.
articles.image_caption: A 10-riyal note issued by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency. The Saudi Central Bank has withdrawn from the mBridge currency platform after completing its pilot in May 2025.
articles.nri_angle: The millions of Indian workers in the Gulf who send money home depend on dollar-denominated settlement networks, so Saudi Arabia's exit keeps that familiar remittance plumbing dominant for now.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NRIs Can Shift NRO Funds to NRE Accounts Up to $1 Million a Year - With New Form 145/146 Paperwork
articles.excerpt: Under RBI's FEMA rules the USD 1 million annual cap is unchanged, but the Income-tax Act, 2025 renamed the transfer paperwork: old Form 15CA is now Form 145 and Form 15CB is now Form 146 - a transition wrinkle that can delay transfers.
articles.image_caption: Indian rupee notes. NRIs can now shift up to $1 million a year from NRO accounts to NRE accounts.
articles.nri_angle: This is core diaspora personal finance: NRIs with Indian rental income, dividends or property-sale proceeds routinely need to repatriate, and the form renaming is exactly the detail that trips up filers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Replacing Russian Barrels Will Hike Costs for Indian Refiners, Industry Warns
articles.excerpt: With Trump having signed the Russia sanctions law authorising up to 100% tariffs on top buyers of Russian oil, India's refiners face costlier spot cargoes, freight and insurance - just as Russian crude hit a record 55% share of imports.
articles.image_caption: Indian refiners warn costs will rise as they replace discounted Russian barrels with alternative crude supplies.
articles.nri_angle: US-based readers have direct skin in this game: tariffs of up to 100% on Indian goods would raise prices on Indian exports to the US and strain the US-India economic relationship.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: EPF Wage Ceiling Raised to Rs 25,000 After 12 Years: What It Means for Your Take-Home Pay
articles.excerpt: Effective September 17, 2026, mandatory PF coverage extends to workers earning up to Rs 25,000 a month - adding about 51 lakh employees to EPFO but cutting take-home pay by up to Rs 1,200 for those previously capped.
articles.nri_angle: Relevant for NRIs relocating back to India who take Indian payroll jobs - the higher ceiling changes offer-negotiation math.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jewellers Face Higher Hallmarking Costs as Festive, Wedding Demand Picks Up
articles.excerpt: The BIS raised the gold hallmarking fee 67% to Rs.75 per article from September 14, just as buying season begins — and jewellery stocks slid on the news.
articles.image_caption: A jeweller displays gold necklaces and earrings at a store in India. Hallmarking costs are rising for jewellers as festive and wedding-season demand picks up.
articles.nri_angle: The hike lands in wedding and festive buying season, when many NRIs purchase gold in India, adding a fixed compliance layer to lightweight pieces in particular.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Software Exports Jump 8.2% to $221.4 Billion as US Share Grows
articles.excerpt: The RBI's annual survey shows American clients now account for 54.1% of exports, with total receipts including overseas operations hitting $239.3 billion.
articles.image_caption: Employees work at desks inside an Indian IT services office. India's software exports rose 8.2% to $221.4 billion in FY26, with the US share growing, according to an RBI survey.
articles.nri_angle: Deepening US concentration means Indian IT's fortunes — and those of Indian tech workers and investors exposed to the sector — are tied to American corporate technology spending.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
